label: Hitler invasion of Russia leading to eventual defeat

source_assertions.title: Horary Astrology and the Judgment of Events
source_assertions.raw_file: horary_knowledge/Horary Astrology and the Judgment of Events (Barbara H. Watters) (Z-Library).txt
source_assertions.claim: Watters says that when Hitler invaded Russia in 1941 Jupiter was in Germany's first house but Saturn was also there, which could be read as initial German victories but eventual defeat.

label: Arab defeat in the Six Day War under retrograde Mars

source_assertions.title: Horary Astrology and the Judgment of Events
source_assertions.raw_file: horary_knowledge/Horary Astrology and the Judgment of Events (Barbara H. Watters) (Z-Library).txt
source_assertions.claim: Watters says the Arabs closed the Port of Eilat and started the Six Day War with Israel on a retrograde Mars, and that when judging the outbreak of war it is the aggressor nation which suffers from the retrograde Mars while victory goes to the defenders.

label: Persian defeat at Gaugamela after eclipse warnings

source_assertions.title: The Annotated Raphael's Mundane Astrology
source_assertions.claim: Louis says the lunar eclipse of September 20 tipped the balance in favor of Alexander, that the Persian army became demoralized, and that invisible Jupiter with prominent Saturn was ominous for King Darius before his defeat at Gaugamela.
